answer: Promotion is logged in zenith and mirror recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 8 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the raven. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and as a result a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 76 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
